extDescription.message: Dark mode for every website. Free, private, open source.

popupThemeGroup.description: Popup: accessible name of the theme segmented control

popupThemeDarkLabel.description: Popup: VoiceOver label of the Dark segment

popupThemeMidnightLabel.description: Popup: VoiceOver label of the Midnight segment

popupThemeDimLabel.description: Popup: VoiceOver label of the Dim segment

popupThemeOnlyOn.description: Popup: caption when this site has its own theme

popupThemeUseDefault.description: Popup: removes this site's theme override

popupNoAccessTitle.message: Duskling can't see this page yet.
